chapter.p: To compel the poor. It means you are willing to offer or engage in charitable actions when there is an expectation of receiving something in return. The poor are not to be extorted1 (see T&C 46:4).

div.p: 1 “Zion,” 40 Years in Mormonism Lecture Series, Lecture 6, April 12, 2014, Grand Junction, Colorado, paper, 11.
